description: Compare scenarios through the WorkbookAPI hosted API. Sends the model id and the scenarios, output names and as_of value given. Bills each returned API row that has outputs. Probes one scenario, then sends at most one more batch sized for the response budget. Returns indexed rows, request_ids, billing totals and resume advice. Unsent rows are not billed; any rows dropped after calculation are reported and were billed if they had outputs. A lost response may still be billed. Never retries automatically.

as_of.description: Calculation moment: YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339 date-time with offset; omitted uses today.

model_id.description: Hosted model id returned by upload_model.

outputs.description: Declared output names; omitted selects all declared outputs.

scenarios.description: 1 to 10,000 scenarios, each with its own inputs; rows come back in the same order.

inputs.description: Declared input names mapped to scalar values; omitted inputs keep their saved values.

name: run_scenarios
